> Teaching story. Living project architecture for humans and review grounding. Not Typology seed evidence (see `evidence/typology/architecture_brief.md`).
Gitboard operates through a pattern of discrete jobs and access doors, separating the local orchestration of git data from the presentation of that data.
### Doors (Entrypoints)
The system provides two primary ways to interact with the local state:
The Server Door: The `gitboard serve` command launches the HTTP server, providing the dashboard interface for visualizing CI status, MRs, and worktree state.
The CLI Door: The `gitboard sync` command acts as the primary entrypoint for state updates, driving the discovery and aggregation processes.
### Jobs (Objective Ledger)
Rather than a single monolithic process, Gitboard executes specialized jobs to transform raw git and forge data into actionable insights:
Project Discovery (`syncproj`): Aggregates project selection and identifies local repository scopes.
Remote Integration (`remotegit` & `localgit`): Synchronizes metadata between local git state and remote forge providers (GitHub/GitLab).
Triage (`triage`): Analyzes project logs and job information to produce root cause summaries for failed tasks.
Maintenance (`pruneagent`): Investigates and manages local-only or removable branches to maintain repository hygiene.
This separation ensures that the heavy lifting of data analysis and remote synchronization remains decoupled from the web-based dashboard serving.
